sections.title: Materia Leveling & DMW Mechanics
sections.summary: Exact hidden EXP counter mechanics, slot 1–6 reels, Moogle Power, and the M1-1-1 AFK mastering setup.

blocks.heading: How Materia Leveling Actually Works
blocks.body: Each equipped Materia (slots 1–6) has a hidden EXP counter. Whenever the DMW reels spin and land on two matching numbers in slots 1–6 (e.g., 2-2-x or x-5-5), the Materia in that numbered slot gains level-ups (or +2/+3 levels on triple matches!).

blocks.heading: Moogle Power & M1-1-1 AFK Mastering Loop
blocks.body: Unlock Moogle Power in M8-4-4. Equip 1–2 mastered Moogle Power Materia (to boost Cait Sith/Moogle DMW limit breaks that level all equipped Materia simultaneously) alongside the Materia you want to master, plus auto-regen/status immunity. Enter M1-1-1 (Shinra's Basic Training), leave Zack guarding or idling while weak troopers chip minimal damage, and let the DMW passively master your entire loadout.

sections.title: Materia Fusion & Stat-Farming Pipelines
sections.summary: Chapter 4 Item Fusion Tome (M7-2-1), Potion HP% stacking, Mako/Stat Stones, Dark Matter (M6-6-3), and Libra conversion loops.

blocks.heading: Step 1: Item Fusion Tome & Potion HP% Rule
blocks.body: Clear M7-2-1 in Chapter 4 to unlock Item Fusion. CRITICAL RULE: Consumables like Potions, Hi-Potions, Ethers, and Elixirs ONLY amplify an EXISTING matching stat bonus on one of the two Materia! Fusing two +0% Materia with 99 Potions produces +0%. Start with an HP Up (+10% HP) or any Materia that already carries HP%, then fuse cheap Shinra Shop Potions (20 Potions = +10% HP) to scale up to +999% HP.

blocks.heading: Step 2: Mako Stones, Stat Stones & Max-Tier Catalysts
blocks.body: Mako Stones require 5 per step (max +40 / +400%); Stat Stones require 3 per step (max +66 / +660%). Max-tier items grant +1 per item up to +100 (or +10% up to +999%): Hero Drink (ATK), Adamantite (VIT), Dark Matter (MAG), Mythril (SPR), Gysahl Greens (LCK), Fat Chocobo Feather (HP%), Lunar Harp (MP%), Zeio Nut (AP%).

blocks.heading: Step 3: The Libra 98 / 980% Conversion Loop
blocks.body: Do NOT push an intermediate stat-stick Materia to +99 or +999%—once maxed, some recipes lock out item upgrades. Stop your cheap Libra transfer Materia at +98 (or +980% HP), then fuse it with your target skill (e.g., Costly Punch or Curaga) plus 1–2 final catalyst items (e.g., Dark Matter or Mythril) to transfer the full +100 / +999% bonus cleanly.

sections.title: EXP / SP / Gil Routes by Level
sections.summary: Targeted mission loops including M6-6-3 (Dark Matter), M8-6-4 (Scissor Chitins), and M9-5-3 (Three Stars).

blocks.heading: M6-6-3: Dark Matter & Early Endgame Gil
blocks.body: Equip Mog's Amulet (rare drops guaranteed) and Jeweled Ring (doubles drops). Run M6-6-3 and farm Lesser Worms for Dark Matter drops/steals—convert unneeded Dark Matter into MAG +100 Libra bases or sell excess.

blocks.heading: M8-6-4: Scissor Chitins (EXP & Gil)
blocks.body: One of the fastest late-game EXP and Gil loops. Clear the mission or chain random encounters with Costly Punch / Hell Blizzaga + Status Ward.

blocks.heading: M9-5-3: Three Stars (Endgame SP & Gil)
blocks.body: The premier SP & Gil farming mission in Reunion. Combine Mog's Amulet + Costly Punch + Mug/Steal to fund 1,000,000+ SP Materia fusions and Net Shop Shade purchases (Genji Helm).

sections.title: Hard Mode Combat Meta & Break Limit Gear
sections.summary: Essential Hard Mode defensive layers, Status Ward + Hell-aga crowd control, Costly Punch, Aerial Drain, and Genji equipment.

blocks.heading: Defense First: Barrier, MBarrier, Wall & 255 VIT/SPR
blocks.body: On Hard Mode, enemy ATK/MAG scaling punishes glass cannons. Maintain Wall (or Barrier + MBarrier) constantly, push VIT and SPR toward 255 for 10★ missions, and equip Adaman Bangle (M7-3-6) early for Break HP Limit until you obtain Genji Armor.

blocks.heading: Offense: Costly Punch & Aerial Drain
blocks.body: Equip Brutal (M7-4-6) or Genji Glove (M9-6-4) for Break Damage Limit (99,999). Costly Punch ignores enemy DEF/VIT and scales off Zack's HP—pairing it with 99,999 HP deals capped 99,999 damage per swing. Aerial Drain gives invulnerability frames + full HP recovery.

blocks.heading: Mob Clearing: Status Ward + Hell-aga
blocks.body: Link Status Ward with Hell Firaga / Hell Blizzaga / Hell Thundaga to grant Zack immunity to Poison, Silence, Stun, Stop, and Death simultaneously while casting AoE Death/status nukes.

blocks.heading: Genji Checklist
blocks.body: Genji Helm: Buy from Net Shop Shade (unlocked in M9-5-4) for 1,000,000 Gil. Genji Armor: Achieve 100% DMW progress. Genji Shield: Magic Pot encounter in M7-6-6 (use Gil Toss, Costly Punch, 99,999 dmg, Octaslash). Genji Glove: Chest in M9-6-4.
